mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, real_name AS realName, status, force_password_change AS forcePasswordChange, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, username, password, real_name AS realName, status, force_password_change AS forcePasswordChange, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}

SELECT id, username, password, real_name AS realName, status, force_password_change AS forcePasswordChange, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM sys_user
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( username, password, real_name, status, force_password_change, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{status}, #{forcePasswordChange}, NOW(), #{createUser} )
